All source writes remain inside canonical dev.godot_lock; one actual canonical child per cell is registered and closed before selection/restoration or lock release.

Uncooperative external modification between final observation and OS replacement remains a disclosed TOCTOU limit; this is a cooperative-lock custody safeguard, not an OS atomic compare-and-swap guarantee.
